cards.name: Coveted Prize
cards.oracleText:
This spell costs {1} less to cast for each creature in your party. (Your party consists of up to one each of Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, and Wizard.)
Search your library for a card, put it into your hand, then shuffle. If you have a full party, you may cast a spell with mana value 4 or less from your hand without paying its mana cost.

cards.name: Premature Burial
cards.oracleText: Destroy target nonblack creature that entered since your last turn ended.

cards.name: Gaea's Bounty
cards.oracleText: Search your library for up to two Forest cards, reveal those cards, put them into your hand, then shuffle.

cards.name: Pirate's Prize
cards.oracleText: Draw two cards. Create a Treasure token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.")
